prompts.side: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated equipment-layer sprite for a chibi pixel-art ARPG hero, a two-handed axe, SIDE view. Draw exactly ONE heavy broad bearded STEEL AXEHEAD mounted on a LONG STRAIGHT BROWN WOOD SHAFT, dark steel socket and two simple dark metal reinforcing bands near the head; brown wrapped grip toward butt, simple small steel buttcap. One cutting blade, small squared rear poll. No gold, ornament, magic or gemstones. Axe is held almost horizontal: shaft butt at lower-left, broad axe head at upper-right, axis only 12 degrees up toward right. Whole item visibly spans about 300-330 pixels inside a 1024x1024 TRANSPARENT PNG canvas, centered with at least 200 pixels completely clear margin on every side. Actual pixel-art raster object with clean square cluster edges, no painterly antialiasing or blurry gradients. This is an empty equipment layer: NO body, NO hands, NO owner, no shadow, no lighting bloom, no VFX, no scenery, no text, no labels, no grid. Entire axe including cutting tip and buttcap stays inside canvas. Preserve truly transparent background.
